data.raw_text:
[9:20PM] #Maryland_Ikeja #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is moving well from Anthony to Maryland intersection, Odo Yalaro, and Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way in both directions. 
Movement is also smooth on Oba Akran Road, Kodesoh Road, Local Airport Road, and Oba Akinjobi Way in Ikeja GRA. 
Both Oba Akran Link Bridge and Airport Link Bridge are clear. 
Officers are on ground managing traffic.

#FollowLASTMA

Eko Bridge to Apongbon and CMS is moving well, with good flow through UBA Roundabout and Marina. 
No impediments reported, and officers are visible on ground managing traffic.
